workspace.description: Lasius workspace root holding specs/ (base.toml) and repos/ (the fleet). standard.sh resolves it from its own location, but the campaign cds here first — REQUIRED per deployment or via STANDARD_SWEEP_WORKSPACE.

cron.description: Nightly sweep schedule (5-field cron). Default 41 4 * * * America/Sao_Paulo — off-peak, staggered from other fleet jobs.

mimus.description: Path to the mimus binary. Empty → standard.sh's own resolution: $MIMUS/PATH, then repos/mimus/target/debug/mimus dev build.

repos.description: Space-separated repo subset passed to scripts/standard.sh. Empty → whole fleet (strigi skipped as archived).

results_dir.description: Rolling output dir — last.log (full sweep output) + last.rc (exit code) overwritten each run. Env STANDARD_SWEEP_RESULTS_DIR; default $HOME/.local/share/standard-sweep.

timeout.description: Per-run cap in seconds for the whole fleet sweep. FIXED at 1800 — params.timeout rejects templated values, so this knob is documented but not wired.
